info.title: Login Security API
info.description: Sign people out when idle, limit session length, turn off remember me and require a second factor at login.

bearerAuth.description: Session token sent in the Authorization header as Bearer and the token.

cookieAuth.name: jwt
cookieAuth.description: Session JWT cookie set at sign-in. When present, it takes precedence over the Authorization header.

apiKeyAuth.description: API key sent in the Authorization header as Bearer and the key, which starts with tmx_. It acts as the key owner and cannot act as anyone else.

get.summary: Idle timeout for the signed in user
get.description: The idle timeout in minutes, 0 when off. The app uses it to sign out after a time without activity.

post.description: Sent while someone works in a terminal or another view that makes no other requests, so the server does not end the session as idle.

get.description: Admin only. The second factors installed plugins provide, so the settings page can warn when a second factor is required but none is installed.
